## Setting Up Inclusion–Exclusion

Let $A$ = multiples of 3, $B$ = multiples of 5 in $\{1,2,\dots,1000\}$.

$$S = S_3 + S_5 - S_{15}$$

where $S_{15}$ corrects for numbers divisible by both 3 and 5 (i.e., by 15) being counted twice.

## Computing Each Piece

The sum of the first $n$ multiples of $d$ is $\;d\cdot\dfrac{n(n+1)}{2}$.

### $S_3$ — multiples of 3

$$\lfloor 1000/3\rfloor = 333 \qquad (3\times333=999)$$

$$S_3 = 3\cdot\frac{333\cdot334}{2} = 3\cdot 55\,611 = 166\,833$$

$$S_{15} = 15\cdot\frac{66\cdot67}{2} = 15\cdot 2\,211 = 33\,165$$

# Smallest Positive Integer Divisible by All Integers from 1 to 20

## The Key Idea

The smallest number divisible by every integer from 1 to 20 is the **Least Common Multiple (LCM)** of {1, 2, 3, …, 20}. To compute it, we take the **highest power of each prime** that appears in the factorization of any number in that range.

## Prime Factorization of Each Number (1–20)

| Number | Prime Factorization |
|--------|-------------------|
| 1 | — |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 | 3 |
| 4 | 2² |
| 5 | 5 |
| 6 | 2 · 3 |
| 7 | 7 |
| 8 | **2³** |
| 9 | **3²** |
| 10 | 2 · 5 |
| 11 | **11** |
| 12 | 2² · 3 |
| 13 | **13** |
| 14 | 2 · 7 |
| 15 | 3 · 5 |
| 16 | **2⁴** |
| 17 | **17** |
| 18 | 2 · 3² |
| 19 | **19** |
| 20 | 2² · 5 |

## Selecting the Highest Power of Each Prime

| Prime | Highest power needed | Reason |
|-------|---------------------|--------|
| 2 | **2⁴ = 16** | 16 = 2⁴ is in the range |
| 3 | **3² = 9** | 9 = 3² is in the range |
| 5 | **5¹ = 5** | 5 is in the range (25 > 20, so no higher power) |
| 7 | **7¹ = 7** | 7 is in the range (49 > 20) |
| 11 | **11¹ = 11** | 11 is in the range |
| 13 | **13¹ = 13** | 13 is in the range |
| 17 | **17¹ = 17** | 17 is in the range |
| 19 | **19¹ = 19** | 19 is in the range |

## Computing the LCM

$$\text{LCM} = 2^4 \times 3^2 \times 5 \times 7 \times 11 \times 13 \times 17 \times 19$$

Step-by-step:

$$2^4 \times 3^2 = 16 \times 9 = 144$$
$$144 \times 5 = 720$$
$$720 \times 7 = 5040$$
$$5040 \times 11 = 55440$$
$$55440 \times 13 = 720720$$
$$720720 \times 17 = 12252240$$
$$12252240 \times 19 = \boxed{232792560}$$

## Answer

$$\text{LCM}(1, 2, 3, \ldots, 20) = 2^4 \cdot 3^2 \cdot 5 \cdot 7 \cdot 11 \cdot 13 \cdot 17 \cdot 19 = \boxed{232{,}792{,}560}$$

This is the smallest positive integer divisible by every integer from 1 to 20.
